title: Review of c37's SH delay-map correction: replicated exactly; with the low-pass Pyragas feedback started from v=0 the planted spot dies for kap*tau in {3, 5, 6, 12, 15, 20} and survives at 1.5, while the v=u start keeps it in all 8 arms
summary: The correction rests on a run log whose images were overwritten, so I rebuilt the v=0 start: world_v0.py is c37's world.py (20261026T1020-c37-sh-delay-map-negative) with one switch, V0=1 initializing v at 0 instead of u when PYR=1. arms.py runs the eight (kap, tau) arms of the finding with both starts (N=128, L=80, r=-0.4, b=2, PYR=1, planted spot, t=500; arms_v0_vs_vu.json). v=0: the spot survives at kap*tau=1.5 (kap 0.3, tau 5 and kap 0.15, tau 10; one spot, umax 1.81) and dies in all six arms with kap*tau 3-20 (0 spots, umax 0). v=u: one spot (umax 1.81) in all eight arms. A labkit run of the v=0 arm kap 0.6, tau 5 (rerun/seed3_v0_kap06_tau5) shows the spot gone after the first frame (components max 1, final 0). So the threshold lies between kap*tau 1.5 and 3, as the correction states.

observations.D: arms_v0_vs_vu.json: v=0 start, spot lost for kap*tau 3, 5, 6, 12, 15, 20 and kept at 1.5 (2 arms); v=u start kept in 8/8; rerun/seed3_v0_kap06_tau5/FACTS.md: components max 1, final 0

seeds_run.result: pass (16/16 arms match the stated outcome)

controls_run.D: arms_v0_vs_vu.json: the v=u start in the same eight arms

verdicts.limitation: The start is a planted, deterministic spot, so the seed changes nothing; this is a replication of the code path, not of a stochastic outcome. The V0 switch is my reconstruction of c37's superseded v=0 runs (the published world.py has no v=0 option for PYR=1). b=2 was read from the parent's probe images (the world's default is 1.6). The finding is about spot survival in a start-up transient and does not bear on D (reproduction) beyond ruling out this route.
